about_the_game:
Eternal Hunt is an action-packed roguelite experience in the style of Vampire Survivors. Players battle waves of enemies, collect loot, and permanently strengthen their character.

Game Features:

Endless Enemy Waves: Face different enemy types such as flying eyes, red orbs, and robots. Each wave brings a greater challenge.

Different Cards: As players progress, they can choose upgrade cards to customize their character. Speed, attack, abilities, and more await.

Powerful Bosses: Bosses with unique attack patterns and high durability challenge you. Each victory grants great rewards.

New Outfits: Customize your character with different costumes. Some unlock through quests, others as rewards.

Rage Mode & Combo System: Enter rage mode to enhance abilities. Combos increase rage power, making attacks deadlier.

2-Player Coop: Play with a friend, defeat waves, and conquer bosses together.

Leaderboard: Compete for the highest score and reach the top!

Immersive Visuals: Pixel art style delivers both action and atmosphere.

Simple but Fun: No complex controls. Just fight, survive, and grow stronger.

Eternal Hunt is fast-paced, action-filled, and addictive. Each run is a new adventure worth replaying.

Goal: Survive, defeat bosses, build combos, and climb the leaderboard!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Pro / Intel Iris Graphics or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound device
